# #4925: Patch: fold the e2e replay check through one jackioh call instead of tsx plus two
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The browser-game replay check that specs 01, 13, 22 and 48 run would go through one engine call instead of three processes. Nobody watching the suite would see a different result; the people running the suite would hit one fewer missing-tool failure, and the e2e package would work standalone the way its README says it does.

## Why

Each `replayCheck` today shells from the Cypress task to the repo root's `tsx`, which runs `support/tasks/replay-runner.ts`, which spawns the release `jackioh` binary twice: once for `replay` (fold the log) and once for `hash-state` (hash the browser's state) (`e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts`, `e2e/support/tasks/replay-runner.ts`, `e2e/support/commands.ts`). Three failure seams for one comparison: the `tsx is missing` error when the repo root was never installed, a `jackioh` binary that is absent, and last-line JSON parsing of CLI output. The first seam is real: `e2e/package.json` has no `tsx` dependency while `e2e/README.md` says `cd e2e && pnpm install` works alone, so a standalone e2e install fails every replay check. The direction of travel is already set: #4772/#4766 moved the hashing into the engine precisely so no TypeScript copy of the recipe lives in e2e. `crates/tools/src/replay.rs` already has both halves as pure functions (`replay_json` and `hash_state_json`); only the single-call composition is missing. `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` holds the tools README table to the CLI surface, so the new mode needs its README row, which keeps it documented.

## Proposal

Add one `jackioh` mode (e.g. `replay-check`) that reads `{seed, decks, log, state, handicaps?, dealt?}` on stdin and prints `{replayHash, browserHash, errors}`, implemented by composing the existing `replay_json` and `hash_state_json` paths. Rewrite `e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts` to `execFileSync` the built CLI once with the payload and return its answer, deleting `replay-runner.ts` and the `tsx` requirement; keep writing the `artifacts/<label>.json` evidence file from the task. Add the mode's row to `crates/tools/README.md` and a unit test in `crates/tools` covering the combined answer, including a refused-action log and an undecodable state.

## Where it lands

- `crates/tools/src/replay.rs` (new mode) and its dispatch in `crates/tools/src/main.rs`
- `crates/tools/README.md` (new row; held by `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`)
- `e2e/support/tasks/replay.ts` (simplified), deleted `e2e/support/tasks/replay-runner.ts`
- No SPEC section; SURFACE §12 documents the existing `replay`/`hash-state` contract this composes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-tools` passes, including the new combined-mode test (clean game, refused action, bad state).
- [ ] The e2e smoke specs that use the check (01, 13) pass unmodified, since the task's contract is unchanged.
- [ ] With only `e2e/` installed (no repo-root `node_modules/.bin/tsx`), the replay check runs instead of throwing the tsx-missing error.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` pass.

## Size and risks

Small to medium: one small CLI mode plus deleting ~95 lines of task plumbing. Risk is CLI-surface growth; the acceptance-held README row keeps it listed, and the task contract (and every spec calling it) stays the same.
